title: make repin leaves the viewer's ui pin where it is
foundBy: user report (host): "is make repin also repinning the npm dependency on the ui npm package in the ledger, tracer and campaign projects?"
details: `make repin` moves the codesweep-ai tools in `go.mod` to the last commit each one's CI built, and stops there. The viewer's `@codesweep-ai/ui` pin in `dispatch-viewer/app/package.json` stays where it was set by hand. It moves only through oss-repin, which needs every sibling checked out beside this one. A clone of this repository alone has no way to take ui's last build.
